title: Superlatives: the most precise, one of the most important

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *el/la más* from B1 Unit 7: *el/la/los/las* + *más* + adjective says "the most …". In history we often say "one of the most …": *uno de los calendarios más precisos de su época*. After a superlative, "in" or "of" is *de*.

items.spanish: Venus es el planeta más brillante del cielo.
items.english: Venus is the brightest planet in the sky.

items.spanish: El calendario maya fue uno de los más precisos de su época.
items.english: The Maya calendar was one of the most precise of its time.

items.spanish: El Coricancha era el templo más importante del imperio.
items.english: The Coricancha was the most important temple of the empire.

items.spanish: El Templo Mayor era uno de los edificios más grandes de Tenochtitlan.
items.english: The Templo Mayor was one of the biggest buildings in Tenochtitlan.

sections.content: With *uno de los* the noun is plural and the adjective agrees with it: *uno de los calendarios más precisos*, *una de las ciudades más grandes*. For "the least" use *menos*: *el menos importante*. The word for "of/in" after a superlative is *de* (*del cielo*), never *en*.
